mapper.select: select id, draft_payload_json as "draftPayloadJson", published_version_id as "publishedVersionId", max_concurrent_jobs as "maxConcurrentJobs", update_by as "updateBy", update_time as "updateTime" from kb_index_policy where id = 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_index_policy (id, draft_payload_json, published_version_id, max_concurrent_jobs, update_by, update_time) values (1, #{draftPayloadJson}, #{publishedVersionId}, coalesce(#{maxConcurrentJobs}, 2), #{updateBy}, current_timestamp) on conflict (id) do update set draft_payload_json = coalesce(excluded.draft_payload_json, kb_index_policy.draft_payload_json), published_version_id = coalesce(excluded.published_version_id, kb_index_policy.published_version_id), max_concurrent_jobs = coalesce(excluded.max_concurrent_jobs, kb_index_policy.max_concurrent_jobs), update_by = excluded.update_by, update_time = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select * from kb_index_policy_version order by version_no desc limit #{limit}
select v.* from kb_index_policy p join kb_index_policy_version v on v.version_id = p.published_version_id where p.id = 1
select count(*) from kb_index_job where status in ('PENDING','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: insert into kb_index_job ( kb_id, job_type, from_version_id, to_version_id, status, progress, doc_total, doc_done, impact_json, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{kbId}, #{jobType}, #{fromVersionId}, #{toVersionId}, #{status}, coalesce(#{progress},0), coalesce(#{docTotal},0), coalesce(#{docDone},0), #{impactJson}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update kb_index_job set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, doc_total = #{docTotal}, doc_done = #{docDone}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, impact_json = #{impactJson}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} where job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: select j.*, k.kb_name from kb_index_job j left join kb_knowledge k on k.kb_id = j.kb_id where j.job_id = #{jobId}
select j.*, k.kb_name from kb_index_job j left join kb_knowledge k on k.kb_id = j.kb_id order by j.job_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update kb_knowledge set active_policy_version_id = #{activeVersionId}, desired_policy_version_id = #{desiredVersionId}, previous_policy_version_id = #{previousVersionId}, index_state = #{indexState}, update_time = current_timestamp where kb_id = #{kbId}

update kb_knowledge set embedding_model_code = #{embeddingModelCode}, extract_model_code = #{extractModelCode}, chunk_strategy = #{chunkStrategy}, chunk_size = #{chunkSize}, chunk_overlap = #{chunkOverlap}, graph_enabled = #{graphEnabled}, update_time = current_timestamp where kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.select: select k.kb_id as "kbId", k.kb_name as "kbName", k.active_policy_version_id as "activeVersionId", k.index_state as "indexState", k.status as "status" from kb_knowledge k where k.del_flag = '0' and ( k.active_policy_version_id is distinct from #{publishedVersionId} or k.active_policy_version_id is null ) order by k.kb_id desc limit 200
